requirements.verifier_assertion: gxe.ExpectColumnValuesToBeValidUuid is the core-registered class and its expectation_type == 'expect_column_values_to_be_valid_uuid' (tests/test_outputs.py L300, L312, L346, L349). Class must be importable from both great_expectations.expectations and great_expectations.expectations.core.
UUID check must reject brace-wrapped forms, 32-hex-digit forms without hyphens, urn:uuid:-prefixed forms, and any leading/trailing/internal whitespace variants (tests L389-401, L455-456).
uuid_version parameter's legal set is exactly {1, 3, 4, 5}. Any other value raises ValueError at construction time (tests L415-417). Valid version constraint keeps only matching UUIDs (L424).

gxe.ExpectColumnValuesToBeValidIso8601Datetime is registered under both public namespaces; expectation_type == 'expect_column_values_to_be_valid_iso8601_datetime' (tests L301-303, L315-316, L370-372).
ISO8601 check accepts valid calendar dates and datetimes; space-separated date and time '2026-12-31 23:59:59' is a valid form (tests L466-467).
ISO8601 check rejects compact forms, US-style forms, pure times, and year-month-without-day (tests L472-474).
ISO8601 check catches nonexistent months, nonexistent days, wrongly judged leap years, out-of-range hours/minutes/seconds; hour 24:00 and offset +25:00 rejected (tests L480-481).

gxe.ExpectColumnValuesToBeValidCreditCardNumber registered under both public namespaces; expectation_type == 'expect_column_values_to_be_valid_credit_card_number' (tests L304-306, L318-320, L370-372).
After removing grouping separators, digit count within 13-19 AND passes Luhn check (tests L507-508, L513-514).
CCN check rejects the same digits in integer form, and boolean values (which are int subclass in Python) (tests L527-538).
must_include: format compliance of a string column

requirements.verifier_assertion: gxe.ExpectColumnValuesToBeValidIban registered under both public namespaces; expectation_type == 'expect_column_values_to_be_valid_iban' (tests L307, L321-323, L370-372).

IBAN check accepts valid entries for all dozens of countries in the ISO 13616 / SWIFT registry (including XK) and rejects unregistered country codes and wrong lengths; US country codes rejected (tests L570-571, L589-590).
IBAN check must pass the mod-97 check; values failing checksum rejected (tests L582-584, L619-620).
IBAN check normalizes whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines) and case differences BEFORE validation — not judged invalid because of them (tests L577).
Tightened JSON-parseable check requires top-level to be a JSON object or array; primitives (number/boolean/null/string) rejected (tests L631-641, L671-672).
Tightened JSON check rejects empty strings, whitespace-only strings, non-string values, malformed/truncated JSON (tests L639-653).

Tightened JSON check preserves: expectation_type 'expect_column_values_to_be_json_parseable', map_metric 'column_values.json_parseable', args_keys ('column',), success_keys ('mostly',) (tests L329-336).
JSON-parseable prescriptive template still contains 'values must be parseable as JSON' and references $column (tests L778-779).
must_include: values must be parseable as JSON
